content.summary: Accept the exact final manuscript after a fresh synthesis, numerical, provenance and issue-closure audit. The scientific contribution is supported within its disclosed local assurance limits. This is my final-auditor decision; publication still requires the other two actual final-auditor acceptances.

scope_assessments.validity: Fresh source tracing and exact grid recomputation support the complete support-53 assembly and finite-obstruction equivalence; no unresolved mathematical defect was found.
scope_assessments.claim_limits: Finite exclusion and local formal I(27) remain open. External computed I(27) is acknowledged; no extremal improvement, sharpness, global novelty or independent certification is claimed.
scope_assessments.contrary_evidence: The empty hypothetical class, failed search, non-sharp numerical relaxation and historical renderer overstatement are disclosed or corrected rather than suppressed.
scope_assessments.methods: Actual-family selection, incidence inequalities, codegree caps, finite kernels and injective relabeling have distinct roles; diagnostic enumeration is not promoted into family exclusion.
scope_assessments.reproducibility: The 114-module project rebuild is supported by matching receipts and source hashes. Lean/mathlib/package caches, shared control and unsigned local provenance remain explicit limits.
scope_assessments.ethics: Theoretical work uses attributed sources and discloses agent review, bounded text comparison and absence of human certification; authorization remains local publication only.
scope_assessments.unresolved_objections: All six required revisions have explicit later closure records; no latest finding remains open. Metadata, heading, MathML-assurance, inline-product and link repairs are preserved. No issue remains requiring a new disposition.

checks.method: Reread the final manuscript, SupportFinish53 and its grid source; recomputed both admissible grids; matched all named theorem roots and 114 rebuild receipts to frozen sources.
checks.observation: The 1204 triples maximize at 2250 and the 6031 quadruples at 4475, preserving margins 12 and 13. All eleven named theorem roots pass the allowed-axiom audit; every rebuild receipt is stable, exit-zero and source-matched. All 169 Lean files and three package metadata files match the source manifest.

checks.scope: Final bindings and complete committed closure
checks.method: Verified canonical snapshot/evidence/verification hashes, all ten chained round records, all 120 submission bindings, evidence-locator digests and F38 computation/script links; reconciled every required revision and latest finding.
checks.observation: All hashes and bindings agree; twelve distinct recorded contexts occur per round. Every required issue has an explicit closure, and F38 binds the exact final manuscript while retaining its bounded-corpus limitation. Review counts and hashes establish local integrity, not external authentication or reviewer independence.
